identified_issues: Premature failure declaration and erroneous rollback recommendation triggered by synchronous HTTP 504 timeout on SWIFT_GATEWAY_WORKER.
Monitoring monitor failed to correlate transport-layer gateway timeout with authoritative out-of-band bilateral clearing reconciliation records.
Discrepancy between outbound gateway status (CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT) and actual settlement state on the clearing network.
evidence: Clearing Bank SFTP Bilateral Statement (CAMT.053/MT940 at 08:30:00Z) explicitly lists REF=TX-8102-EUR with CLEARING_ID=EBA-STEP2-9948102, AMT=14850000.00 EUR, STATUS=SETTLED, and VAL_DATETIME=2026-10-06T08:15:02Z.
Bilateral statement explicitly records REJECTION_RECORDS: NONE, confirming the instruction was neither rejected nor cancelled.
Ledger record for batch SETTLE_BATCH_8102 (TX-8102-EUR) is in state COMMITTED with lock_status RELEASED at journal timestamp 2026-10-06T08:15:00.120Z, consistent with clearing settlement.

Outbound gateway log indicates HTTP 504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT occurred at 08:15:03.205Z, subsequent to the clearing value timestamp of 08:15:02Z, demonstrating an edge network timeout rather than an execution failure.
recommended_action: Reject the automated monitoring monitor's rollback recommendation to prevent an erroneous ledger imbalance. Reconcile and transition the outbound gateway status from CALLBACK_PENDING_TIMEOUT to SETTLED based on the authoritative CAMT.053 statement. Update operational monitoring rules to mandate cross-referencing out-of-band clearing reconciliation feeds before initiating transaction rollbacks on HTTP 504 timeout events.
